title: Message envelope, version 1
description: The JSON body of every queue message. Each message schema narrows `type`, `version` and `payload`. The body is authoritative: consumers take the tenant, type and version from it, never from AMQP properties or headers.

messageId.description: Unique per message. Consumers deduplicate on it.

type.description: The message name, such as DocumentUploaded.

version.description: The message version. A breaking change creates a new version.

occurredAt.description: When the publisher recorded the event, RFC 3339 with an offset.

tenantId.description: The tenant the message belongs to. The only source of the tenant for a consumer.

payload.description: The message fields, defined by each message schema.

uuid.description: Lower-case 8-4-4-4-12 form, as Guid.ToString() and Python's str(UUID) write it.

versionNumber.description: The document version's number: 1 for the first upload, then 2, 3, ...
